title: Pulse locale file
description: One file per language. Every key is optional except code; anything missing falls back to en.json.

text.description: May hold {placeholders}. Inserted values are wrapped in Unicode isolates in RTL locales.

ui.description: CSS font stack for UI text, placed before the platform stack.

hero.description: CSS font stack for hero numbers and titles, placed after the platform stack.

forms.description: CLDR categories, plus exact matches such as "=0" that win over them.

code.description: BCP 47 tag. Must match the file name.

label.description: Short label for the switcher, in its own script (EN, ع, DE).

name.description: Language name in its own script (English, العربية).

order.description: Position in the switcher. Defaults: en first, then by code.

fallback.description: Locale to fall back to. Defaults to en.

numberingSystem.description: Unicode numbering system for digits (latn, arab, arabext, deva...). Defaults to latn.

ui.description: CSS font stack for UI text, placed before the platform stack.

hero.description: CSS font stack for hero numbers and titles, placed after the platform stack.

pluralRules.description: CLDR plural rules (https://www.unicode.org/cldr/charts/latest/supplemental/language_plural_rules.html). Omit to use Intl.PluralRules.

apps.description: English app name to localized name. Unlisted apps keep their name.
